news.regional: Marathi daily, Thu 15 Oct (translated): rain has damaged kharif onion ready for harvest in Niphad and Yeola talukas. Farmers estimate 35–45% of the standing crop is affected. New-crop arrivals, usually from mid-October, may be two to three weeks late.
news.stock_limit: Business daily, Wed 14 Oct: the Centre is "considering" onion stock limits for traders and large buyers if retail prices keep rising. No order has been notified.

state.cold_store: Own cold store at Chakan, QC report Thu 15 Oct: 119 t of rabi onion stored since May. Sprouting 7.7%, rot 6.3%. QC advice: use within 11 days; expect about 19% sorting loss. Also 60 t of spot-lot onion received Sat 10 Oct, usable until Fri 23 Oct, about 12% sorting loss.
state.open_orders: No open orders; no dehydrated flakes on hand.
state.production_plan: Onion use 6 t per production day, Monday to Saturday. Makhani gravy and pav bhaji base take about half of it. QSR customers run no onion-garlic Navratri menus 11–19 Oct, so onion gravy orders for those days are down about 40%. Diwali gravy and snack orders peak in the two weeks before Lakshmi Puja on Sun 8 Nov. Key QSR contract: ₹50,000 penalty per day of short supply.
state.supply_options: (1) Spot lot at Lasalgaon through the commission agent: 60 t of old rabi onion for delivery tomorrow at about ₹32.3 per kg (about ₹19.4 lakh); usable for about two weeks after delivery. (2) Mahuva dehydrated-onion processor: 8 t of flakes, dispatch in five days, ₹228 per kg (₹18.2 lakh), 12-month shelf life; the supplier says 1 kg replaces 8 to 9 kg of fresh onion.
state.policy: (a) The purchase manager may approve up to ₹25 lakh per purchase decision; above that needs the CFO. (b) Dehydrated onion may be used only in recipes that passed the sensory trial: makhani gravy and pav bhaji base (two of five gravies). (c) Total onion held must stay within any stock limit in force. (d) QSR penalty orders are produced before modern-trade orders. (e) Recommendations only: never place orders, pay agents or contact customers. (f) Buy a 60 t spot lot only if it removes at least 15 t of the shortfall projected before new kharif onion arrives; order 8 t of flakes only if they remove at least 5 t. Otherwise buy nothing.
